why: Gives a value exactly equal to the axis maximum a bin index one past the end of the grid. `max` is precisely the value a range derived from measurements tends to contain -- `SHIPPED_RANGES` is built from measured extremes and then widened -- so the boards lost would be the extreme ones, the most interesting in the sample, and the loss would be silent.
killedBy: expressive range: the sample never sets its own ruler puts a value exactly on the top edge in the last bin rather than off the grid
